verdicts.statement: Fadell–Neuwirth fibration theorem: if M is a manifold without boundary (not necessarily compact) and k >= m >= 1, then the projection map pi_{k,m} (from the configuration space of k points in M to the configuration space of m points in M) is a fibration with fiber F(M - Q_m, k-m).
If G is a torsion-free group and H is a subgroup of finite index, then the cohomological dimension of G equals the cohomological dimension of H, i.e. cd(G) = cd(H).

verdicts.statement: P. Hall's theorem: if 1 -> N -> G -> Q -> 1 is a short exact sequence of groups with N and Q finitely presented, then G is finitely presented.
